Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

nwrspeciesr 0.2.0

  • Fix package metadata and update README documentation for the experimental authenticated upload API.
  • Harden upload record and evidence validation for missing numeric values, invalid dates, and unknown evidence fields.
  • Add experimental authenticated upload and edit functions for the internal SpeciesUpload API, including permissions, single-record and batch create and replace operations, and evidence URLs.
  • get_species_categories() and get_species_occurrences() document their API-version-specific lookup values.
  • get_species_list() now reports mutual refuge_code/refuge_name errors with a package-specific class.
  • Add file-backed downloads through the path argument of download_species_list().
  • Add structured API and response-schema errors for programmatic error handling.
  • Improve validation, refuge-name matching, API timeouts, and retry handling.
  • Add automated R CMD check coverage for release and development R on Linux and Windows.
  • Add test coverage reporting and a reproducible README source document.

nwrspeciesr 0.1.0

Initial release. Provides a read-only R interface to the U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service NWRSpecies (formerly FWSpecies) occurrence database.

Features

  • get_species_list() retrieves refuge species occurrence records from the public SpeciesList/items endpoint, with optional filters for region, refuge, taxonomic category, occurrence, and ITIS TSN, plus sorting and pagination.
  • download_species_list() retrieves records from the CSV DownloadFile endpoint.
  • get_species_categories() and get_species_occurrences() return the valid category and occurrence values accepted by the API.
  • get_refuges() retrieves a live refuge name / unit code crosswalk from the FWS Unit REST API via the fwsunitr package.
